name: Annular Fissure of Intervertebral Disc
definition: Fissuring of the annulus fibrosus, commonly seen on MRI and often asymptomatic; clinical significance requires correlation with symptoms and exclusion of other causes.

core: Lumbar/cervical movement assessment depending on level

investigations.principle: MRI can demonstrate high-intensity-zone/annular changes but cannot by itself establish causation.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, tumor, occult injury or condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

green: Treat the clinical syndrome, not the MRI finding
amber: Avoid overdiagnosis and unnecessary procedures based only on annular fissure imaging.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Anatomical MRI finding should remain separate from Ayurvedic phenotype assessment.

patientEducation.summary: Fissuring of the annulus fibrosus, commonly seen on MRI and often asymptomatic; clinical significance requires correlation with symptoms and exclusion of other causes.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
